# Welcome to Viscaria Village

Viscaria Village is Viscaria’s accommodation solution for consultants and construction contractors working on the Viscaria Project. It offers modern and comfortable accommodation close to the project site, with good opportunities for both rest and social interaction outside working hours.

By bringing together people contributing to the project in one place, Viscaria Village creates natural opportunities to connect and helps strengthen the sense of community between Viscaria employees, consultants and contractors.

Adjacent to the Village is a service building for contractors working on site who are not staying at the Village. The service building includes a dining area, changing rooms and showers, providing a practical base during the working day.

Our ambition is to offer more than simply a place to stay. Viscaria Village is designed to be a welcoming environment where people can feel at home during their time working on the project.

## Accommodation bookings and prices

The following rates apply for accommodation at Viscaria Village:

- **SEK 300 per night** for bookings of at least five nights
- **SEK 600 per night** for individual nights, as shorter stays require additional handling, including changes of bed linen

Before your company can book rooms, an accommodation agreement must first be put in place. Please contact our reservations team at [reservations.viscaria@lynra.se](mailto:reservations.viscaria@lynra.se) and they will be happy to assist you.

![Viscaria Village opens for guests.](https://www.viscaria.com/en/wp-content/uploads/sites/2/2026/09/Viscaria_Village_260824_0088-1.jpg)

## The service building – for all contractors

The service building at Viscaria Village is available to contractors working on site who are not staying at the Village. It includes a dining area, changing rooms, showers and shared facilities that can be used during the working day.

The cost of using the service building is **SEK 500 per person per month**.

Companies wishing to use the service building are welcome to contact our reservations team at [reservations.viscaria@lynra.se](mailto:reservations.viscaria@lynra.se) for further information and registration.

Gruvaktiebolaget Viscaria is a company that is scaling up to become a modern and responsible producing mining company through the reopening of the Viscaria mine in Kiruna. The deposit’s high copper grade, assessed mineral resources, geographical location and growing team of experienced employees provide good conditions for Viscaria to become an important supplier of high-quality and responsibly produced copper.
